siechen.et: From Middle High German siechen, from siohhēn, from Proto-West Germanic *seukēn. Cognate with Low German süüken, seeken and Swedish sjukna.

Siechenhaus.et: From Middle High German siechenhūs, variant of siechhūs, from Old High German siohhūs (“hospital”), equivalent to siech + Haus. Compare Middle Low German sêkhûs (“hospital”), English sickhouse.
